kept.claim: Revenue for the quarter was $1.31 billion, up 23% from a year earlier and 5.8% from the prior quarter. Management says subscription revenue growth for the year came mainly from adding new customers and selling more sensors and modules to existing customers.

Total deferred revenue was $4.75 billion at quarter end, up 27% from a year earlier and 17% from the prior quarter. The filing explains that deferred revenue is made up of subscriptions and services that are invoiced upfront, usually at the start of the term, and recognized as revenue later.

Operating cash flow for the quarter was $497.9 million, up 44% from a year earlier. For the full year, the filing says operating cash flow reflected non-cash charges such as stock-based compensation, along with an increase in deferred revenue that was partly offset by higher deferred contract acquisition costs and receivables.

Capital expenditures for the quarter were $102.5 million, up 17% from a year earlier. The filing says the year's investing outflows were mainly business acquisitions, purchases of property and equipment, and capitalized internal-use software.
